q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of a blood bag?
title: Blood bag carbon footprint per bag
short: Weigh the PVC film, tubing, needle and anticoagulant per bag set and multiply by supplier figures. Add film making, welding, filling and sterilisation energy, then divide the plant's energy by bag sets made.
audience: Blood bag and medical device makers

ul: Radio-frequency welding and assembly in a clean room.

p: Report per bag set by type, single to quadruple. Clean room air handling can be a large share of the energy.

example.title: Worked example: plant energy per bag (one month)
lines: Plant total: 85,200 / 300,000 = 0.284 kg CO2 per bag
Add PVC, needle and solution for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
